title: Heap based buffer overflow while parsing crafted X.509 certificates
expected_vulnerable_behavior: On wolfSSL v4.2.0-stable with ASan/UBSan and extra certificate/OpenSSL compatibility options, the crafted X.509 certificate triggers UBSan index 19 out of bounds in GetName at wolfcrypt/src/asn.c:5121, followed by ASan SEGV during FreeDecodedCert.
expected_fixed_behavior: wolfSSL v4.3.0-stable safely rejects the crafted certificate with 'GetLength value exceeds buffer length' and no UBSan/ASan/SEGV/FreeDecodedCert crash.
expected_current_behavior: Current wolfSSL v5.9.1-stable-1299-geeab53205 safely rejects the crafted certificate with 'GetLength - value exceeds buffer length' and no UBSan/ASan/SEGV/FreeDecodedCert crash.
crash_signal: UBSan: index 19 out of bounds for int[19] at wolfcrypt/src/asn.c:5121; ASan: SEGV during FreeDecodedCert at wolfcrypt/src/asn.c:4532; exit code 134.
migration_value: High. X.509/ASN.1 parser boundary pattern can be migrated to OpenSSL and mbedTLS certificate parsing APIs.
notes: Strict reproduction succeeded on wolfSSL v4.2.0-stable commit 48c4b2fedcee4d61b6a76c5ce9e33ab212d6ab4a using the original crafted certificate. The crash requires ASan/UBSan extra build configuration with --enable-opensslextra, --enable-certgen, --enable-certreq, --enable-certext, and --enable-dtls. wolfSSL v4.3.0-stable safely rejects the input and is treated as the fixed release candidate. Current wolfSSL commit eeab53205ab57451778f7a76aad25f5349547ce5 also safely rejects the input. Candidate commit 88bf5d967 was tested but remained vulnerable.
